_comment: BOT Chain network parameters. Every value verified against the live RPC on 2026-08-31, not copied from docs. Never fall back from mainnet to testnet: BOT Chain's own docs warn about this and the vault's token/registry are immutable.
_addresses: verifiedEntityRegistry / educationFundingVault / schoolProfile / edGrantLens stay null until a real deployment exists on that chain. The interface treats null as 'not deployed here' and says so, rather than guessing. Local anvil addresses are written by web/scripts/dev-chain.mjs into web/.env.local, which is gitignored.

localAnvil.name: Local Anvil
localAnvil.notes: Development only. `cd web && npm run devchain` deploys MockUSDT plus all four contracts, seeds a demo, and writes the addresses to web/.env.local. Left null here on purpose: a throwaway chain's addresses do not belong in a reviewed file.

botchainTestnet.name: BOT Chain Testnet (Bohr)
botchainTestnet.notes: Deployed 2026-08-31 from 0xbBdEd8089932ff47e06Ee2A56d6B75530d99126e. Verifier set of 5, threshold 2, verificationFee 0.5 tBOT (immutable). The deploy txs sat in the mempool for ~5.5h while the chain was halted at block 21768657, then mined on resumption. Note the public RPC is load-balanced and nodes can serve inconsistent height/state; retry reads that come back empty rather than concluding a contract is missing.

botchainMainnet.name: BOT Chain Mainnet
botchainMainnet.notes: eth_getLogs is restricted on this public RPC. The dApp must read state through view functions, never by scanning logs.
